GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 19 April 2026.
Tonight:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Central, Sabaragamuwa, Uva,
North-western, North-central and Southern provinces. Fairly heavy falls about 50 mm are likely at
some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.
Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island.
Tomorrow:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at most places of the island after 1.00 pm.
Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central and
North- central provinces and in Kurunegala, Galle and Matara districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva
provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
